name: Empowered Evocation
description: When you cast a damaging Arcane spell, you may burn an additional Diamond after paying the spell's normal casting cost. If the spell hits, it deals 1 additional HP of damage.

name: Elemental Adaptation
description: When casting a damaging Arcane spell, you may change its damage type to another appropriate elemental type. The GM determines whether the new damage type is appropriate for the spell.

name: Potent Cantrip
description: When you cast a Tier 0 damaging cantrip in combat, you may burn a card to enhance the spell. If the spell hits, it deals 1 HP of damage.

name: Resonant Power
description: When casting an Arcane spell, you may burn an additional Diamond after paying the spell's normal cost. The additional Diamond provides its normal +1 resonant bonus and, if the spell deals damage, adds 1 HP to its damage.

name: Spell Shaping
description: When casting an area or multi-target spell, you may exclude one appropriate target from the spell's effect.

name: Overchannel
description: Once per short rest, when casting a damaging Arcane spell, you may burn one additional card to increase the spell's damage by 1 HP.

name: Arcane Penetration
description: Your damaging Arcane spells may partially bypass an enemy's magical resistance. The GM determines how much resistance is overcome based on the creature and spell.

name: Focused Casting
description: When you cast an Arcane spell requiring a magic attack, you may burn an additional Diamond to reroll the attack card before determining whether the spell hits.

name: Master of Elements
description: You may freely change the elemental damage type of your Arcane damaging spells without requiring a special circumstance, provided the new damage type is appropriate to the spell.

name: Arcane Mastery
description: Once per long rest, when casting an Arcane spell of Tier 3 or higher, you may reduce the spell's casting cost by 1 card. The remaining cards must still be paid normally.

name: Minor Illusion
description: You can create a small sensory illusion without spending a spell slot or burning a card when used outside combat. The illusion must be simple and localized.

name: Distracting Illusion
description: Create an illusion that distracts an enemy. The GM may impose an appropriate disadvantage or distraction when the illusion is convincing.

name: Illusory Disguise
description: Create a magical disguise that changes your apparent appearance. The disguise lasts until the end of the scene or until closely examined.

name: Flexible Illusion
description: When casting an illusion spell, you may alter its appearance, sound, or presentation without changing its basic mechanical effect.

name: Phantom Double
description: Create an illusory duplicate of yourself. Until the end of the scene, the duplicate may be used to distract enemies or create uncertainty about your position.

name: Illusory Terrain
description: Create an illusion that changes the apparent appearance of an area. The illusion can conceal doors, create apparent obstacles, disguise paths, or make an area appear dangerous.

name: Misdirection
description: When an enemy targets you with an attack, you may burn a card to create a momentary illusion. The GM may redirect the attack, impose a disadvantage, or allow you to reposition depending on the circumstances.

name: Illusory Escape
description: Once per short rest, when you would be hit by an attack, you may burn a card to create an illusion of yourself in your current position and move to a nearby location.

name: Master of Deception
description: Gain expertise in Deception or Stealth. If you already have expertise in both, gain proficiency in another skill.

name: Grand Illusion
description: Once per long rest, create a powerful illusion capable of affecting an entire scene. The illusion may disguise a location, create convincing creatures or hazards, or radically alter how the area appears. The GM determines its exact limits.
